blocks.text: Meet the Logitech G733 Lightspeed Wireless Gaming Headset, a wireless PC gaming headset designed to suit your style and deliver top-tier performance. Embrace total wireless freedom with 2.4 GHz Lightspeed technology, offering a reliable 20-meter range and up to 29 hours of battery life. Personalize your look and sound in G HUB with dual-zone, front-facing Lightsync RGB lighting and real-time Blue VO!CE mic filters. Equipped with advanced audio technologies, including 40 mm PRO-G audio drivers, internal acoustic chambers, and DTS Headphone: X 2.0; the G733 delivers precise, reduced distortion sound that elevates your gaming experience. Choose from four vibrant colorways and enjoy lasting comfort with a reversible suspension headband, dual-layer memory foam earcups, and a lightweight 278 g design. Whether you’re using it as a gaming headset for PC, a PS5 headset wireless, or a PlayStation headset with a built-in mic, the G733 ensures seamless communication during gameplay. Compatible with multiple platforms, this flexible wireless headset is your ultimate choice for immersive gaming, streaming, and everyday use.

items: Personalize your Logitech wireless gaming headset lighting with 16.8M vibrant colors. Enjoy front-facing, dual-zone Lightsync RGB with preset animations—or create your own using G HUB software.

Total freedom - 20 meter range and Lightspeed wireless audio transmission. Keep playing for up to 29 hours. Play in stereo on PS4. Note: Change earbud tips for optimal sound quality. Uses: Gaming, Personal, Streaming, gaming headphones wireless.

Hear every audio cue with breathtaking clarity and get immersed in your game. PRO-G drivers in this wireless gaming headset with mic reduces distortion and delivers precise, consistent, and rich sound quality.
Advanced Blue VO CE mic filters make your voice sound richer, cleaner, and more professional. Perfect for use with a wireless headset on PC and other devices—customize your audio with G HUB.
Enjoy all-day comfort with a colorful, reversible suspension headband designed for long play sessions. This wireless gaming headset is built for gamers on PC, PS5, PS4, and Nintendo Switch.
